name: Oxyphenbutazone Anhydrous

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 7 other countries, first in 1984 — for blood problems and serious skin reactions

summary: Oxyphenbutazone Anhydrous was removed from the market in the United States and seven other countries starting in 1984 because of harm to the blood and skin [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests in people, estimated a high risk score of 66 for the liver [M]. The same computer model calculated a low risk score of 39 for the heart [M].
